= OIDC

Authenticate injected SOAP clients using Quarkus OIDC Client.
Acquire client-credentials tokens, propagate the current caller's access token,
or exchange it using RFC 8693 without changing generated service interfaces.

[id="quarkus-cxf-oidc-usage"]
== Usage

See xref:user-guide/authentication-authorization.adoc#client-oidc[OIDC authentication for SOAP clients]
for tested examples, token lifecycle settings, and WSDL access.

This extension supports `@CXFClient` proxies using `VertxHttpClientHTTPConduitFactory` in JVM and native applications.
OIDC is disabled by default.
Programmatic JAX-WS clients and other HTTP conduits are outside this integration's scope.

| Configuration property | Type | Default


.<| [[quarkus-cxf_quarkus-cxf-client-client-name-oidc-mode]]`link:#quarkus-cxf_quarkus-cxf-client-client-name-oidc-mode[quarkus.cxf.client."client-name".oidc.mode]`
.<| `disabled`, `acquire`, `propagate`, `exchange`
.<| `disabled`

3+a|Authentication mode: disabled, acquire a client-credentials token, propagate the current caller's
access token, or exchange it using RFC 8693.
Only injected clients using the Vert.x HTTP conduit are supported.

*Environment variable*: `+++QUARKUS_CXF_CLIENT__CLIENT_NAME__OIDC_MODE+++` +
*Since Quarkus CXF*: 4.0.0

.<| [[quarkus-cxf_quarkus-cxf-client-client-name-oidc-client-name]]`link:#quarkus-cxf_quarkus-cxf-client-client-name-oidc-client-name[quarkus.cxf.client."client-name".oidc.client-name]`
.<| `string`
.<| 

3+a|Quarkus OIDC client selected for acquisition or exchange.
When absent, use the default OIDC client.
Ignored in disabled and propagate modes.

*Environment variable*: `+++QUARKUS_CXF_CLIENT__CLIENT_NAME__OIDC_CLIENT_NAME+++` +
*Since Quarkus CXF*: 4.0.0
